_comment: Rules for the parenthesised tags at the end of a TCGplayer product name, e.g. 'Shanks (Parallel) (Manga)'. Every rule whose regex matches a tag applies (case-insensitive). 'treatment' is the art treatment (MTG's frame_effects); 'promo' is a promo type with its card_catalog.promo_types_ref category, reusing MTG's names where one fits (prerelease, release, judgegift, boxtopper, textured). A tag no rule matches is a name disambiguator (a card number or a character name) and labels nothing.
